Discover Casa Joya, a modern and thoughtfully designed 3-bedroom home ideally located in one of Sámara’s most sought-after neighborhoods, Canto de Gavilanes. Well suited for both year-round living and rental use, the property stands out for its prime location and easy walkability to all amenities. Nestled at the end of a dead-end street and set back from the main road, the home enjoys a peaceful and private setting while remaining within walking distance to everything. The beach is just an easy 8-minute walk away, and the vibrant center of Sámara can be reached in 10 minutes, offering a variety of restaurants, cafés, shops, and local conveniences. A large supermarket, liquor store, and other everyday services are also just a short 3-minute walk from the property. Set on a generous 609 Sqm lot, the home features a well-balanced layout with three comfortable bedrooms, each with queen-size beds, three full bathrooms, a half bath for guests, and a dedicated laundry and storage room. The bright and spacious living area is designed for both comfort and flexibility, with a TV lounge and seating that can accommodate additional guests when needed. The fully equipped kitchen opens seamlessly onto a large covered terrace, ideally positioned between the home and the pool. This inviting space creates a natural indoor-outdoor flow, perfect for relaxing, dining, or entertaining year-round. Outside, the property offers a beautifully maintained private garden, a swimming pool, and a fully fenced yard, providing both security and ample space for families, pets, or enjoying the tropical lifestyle. With its combination of location, comfort, and versatility, Casa Joya is an excellent option as a full-time residence, vacation home, or rental property in one of Sámara’s most desirable areas.
